title: Discover Greece
overview:
Inclusions:
• Accommodation: 5 night’s accommodation in Athens and Santorini hotel 
• Transfers: Airport pick up and drop as per your flight timings and round trip transfers in Santorini from port –hotel-airport on the seat in coach basis.
• Ticket: Economy Class Normal Ferry ticket from Athens to Santorini.
• Meals: Breakfast as per the itinerary
• Transport: Comfortable and hygienic vehicle for sightseeing on all days as per the itinerary
• Visa assistance: It will be provided (Charges are not included)
• Guide: Professional guide to help you explore the citiesExperiences Covered:
• Panoramic city tour of Athens city centre
• Photo Stop at the Panathinaikon Stadium
• Guided tour of Acropolis (Propylae the gateway, Temple of Athena Nike, Parthenon, Erechtheion with its Porch of Maidens)
• Guided tour of the Acropolis Museum.
• Volcano Tour in SantoriniNot to Miss in Greece :
• Enjoying a drink at Monastiraki square - one of Athens busiest area
• Sample the wines of antiquity in Santorini
• Hitting the hiking trails from Fira to Oia along the rim of the caldera in SantoriniNote: Package customization available on request. Drop an inquiry to know more.Destination info:

days.title: Arrival in Athens | Welcome to the Greek City
prose: Get ready to indulge in a perfect romantic getaway that you will cherish for eternity; the city of ancient ruins anticipates your arrival
Meet and assist at International Athens Airport and transfer to the hotel
The rest of the day is at leisure to explore this fascinating city of Athens
Overnight stay in Athens

days.title: City Tour with Acropolis Museum | Wander at the UNESCO Heritage
prose: Duration: 5 hours | Pickup / Drop point: Hotel | Transfers: Shared | Pickup Time: 08:00 A.M
Wake up early in the morning and enjoy your scrumptious breakfast at the hotel, and it's time to start exploring Athens

The sightseeing tour will start at 08:00 A.M. and the duration is of 5 hours, the tour will begin from Acropolis to Omonia Square with a photo stop at Panathenaic Stadium which means "beautifully marbled" and is the world's only stadium made entirely of marble
You will then pass the Athens Trilogy, including the University of Athens, the Academy of Athens, and the National Library

Continue passing by National Garden, Hadrian’s Arc, St. Paul’s Church, Parliament, Tomb of the Unknown Soldier, Schliemann’s House (Numismatic Museum), Catholic Cathedral, Old Parliament, Constitution, Square, and Russian Orthodox Church
Continue passing by the temple of Olympian Zeus (visit renovated Propylaea, Temple of Athena Nike, Parthenon and Erchteion)

Finally, reach the Acropolis Museum Tour where you will explore universal symbols of the classical spirit and civilization and form the greatest architectural and artistic complex bequeathed by Greek Antiquity to the world
Return to the hotel or keep explore the remaining day on your own
Overnight stay in Athens

days.title: Athens to Santorini Island | Get awe with whitewashed, cube-shaped buildings
prose: Wake up in the morning and after your breakfast at the hotel, get transfer from your hotel to Piraeus port for embarkation upon a morning ferry for Santorini
Join the ferry from Piraeus Port to Santorini Island which takes about 5 hours to reach and enjoy the blue lagoon views as you travel
As you arrive at Santorini port meet and greet and get transferred to your hotel in Santorini, complete your check in formalities and relax for a while
The rest of the day yours to begin exploring all that this magnificent island has to offer to the visitor
Overnight in Santorini

days.title: Santorini Volcano Tour | Walk over the dried lava and feel the heat
prose: Duration: 09:45-16:00 | Transfers: Shared
Wake up with the view of white houses and blue lagoon and have your leisurely breakfast, later you will proceed for the excursion to Volcano, Hot Springs, Thirassia and Cruise

The tour starts with the bus transfer to the Port of Athinios for boat embarkation and from there it continues to the lava island Nea Kameni where the boat will make a stop to give the explorers the opportunity to walk up the ascending soil path and approach the crater of the still active Volcano
After seeing the crater you will walk back down the dirt path to the boat which will bring you to the second lava island Palea Kameni, where you will find the hot Springs
The boat makes a stop around 50 meters from the opening and you can swim in the green sulphur waters of the hot springs, wet your feet or just enjoy the view

During this tour, you will have the unique chance to visit the active volcano of Santorini, walk on dried lava up to its peak, feel the heat underneath your feet and see the steam of sulphuric gases emerging from the earth bowels. Next, step down into the blue waters in order to swim towards the springs

The tour continues after the hot springs to Thirassia Island which was once part of Santorini before the big Explosion of the Volcano, you will have the opportunity to do some activities like swimming on the beach of Thirassia, have lunch next to the Sea or just explore the Village of Manolas with its winding steps and traditional houses
On the way back to Athinios port where the tour ends you will cruise with the boat under Oia where the best pictures can be taken of the amazing cliffs and the breathtaking scenery
Once you arrive at the port the bus will be waiting to bring you back to the point you started from
After spending such an lovely day come back to your hotel in Santorini for overnight stay

days.title: Santorini to Athens | Return back to the greek city
prose: Today, after breakfast you will be transferred to Santorini port for your way back to Athens
Arrive at Athens port and transferred to your hotel
Overnight stay at Athens

days.title: Departure | End of Experience
prose: Wake up with a mouth-watering breakfast and pack your bags full of unforgettable memories
You will be picked up from your hotel in order to be transferred to Athens airport for your final departure flight
Board the flight and treasure the moments you have spent in this beautiful country
